name: Bee Yard Wingman
notes: The app is a smaller download. Buddy's voice files are smaller, and he sounds the same.
Buddy now says "nosema" the right way.
Voice: "palette" or "pilot" now means pallet, and "next to a pallet" never moves a hive to another yard.
Club officers see new members with whole-club totals, and can let people join the member list only.
Bloom's first and last tabs always stay visible, and the map-key reminder waits a day after you tap Later.
The "?" help on long pages now scrolls, so you can always reach Close.
